conclusions.text: W37 is the first week with real week-over-week comparison (vs W36). Headline: things are steady and ticking up, not volatile.
Snapchat — our largest owned channel — grew +600 followers WoW (89,900 → 90,500). YouTube flat (~2,100 subs, avg recent video views ~1,133 via API).
App Store ratings stable across both apps and all 3 markets (all within ±0.06); rating counts ticking up (KSA English +39, Adults KSA +16) — healthy steady flow, no shocks.
Google Trends: KSA search interest softening again (22 vs ~31 earlier); Kuwait ~0. UAE not captured this week (Google Trends rate-limited the request — data gap, will retry).
Still pending: Hootsuite export (impressions/engagement — 2FA login in progress), Instagram/TikTok API tokens (setup started), and competitor list (Patrick).
